items.original_title: Utah governor designates Sept. 10 as 'Charlie Kirk Day' 1 year after assassination
items.rss_summary: Utah Gov. Spencer Cox announced Thursday that Sept. 10 would be known as “Charlie Kirk Day” in Utah, a year after the political commentator was assassinated in the state. “One year ago today, Charlie Kirk came to Utah to take part in a fundamental American tradition: speak openly, debate ideas, and persuade others,” he said...
